title: French firefighters launch nationwide calendar competition to support Injured crews
summary: Every winter in France, firefighters sell calendars to raise funds for a nonprofit organization that supports injured firefighters and the families of those who have died in the line of duty, and this year the tradition includes the fourth edition of a nationwide calendar competition, with 128 fire stations inviting the public to vote for the best design, a…
contentText: Every winter in France, firefighters sell calendars to raise funds for a nonprofit organization that supports injured firefighters and the families of those who have died in the line of duty, and this year the tradition includes the fourth edition of a nationwide calendar competition, with 128 fire stations inviting the public to vote for the best design, as our colleagues at France Télévisions, Alexis Fischer, Mathieu Dreujou, and Claire Combaluzier, along with France 24’s Florent Marchais, report.
